articles.title: AI, Drones, and ‘COWs’: Inside the High-Tech Hurricane Prep of Cell Carriers
articles.summary: Before a hurricane even forms, Verizon and AT&T are moving drones, barges, and portable cell towers into position. Using AI to pinpoint damage, they can restore service in minutes — but first responders always get priority. Here’s how the invisible network stays alive when the wind howls.

articles.title: Trump’s ‘American Flag Blue’ Reflecting Pool Sparks Lawsuit and a $14.8 Million Price Tag
articles.summary: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool has been repainted a deep blue at President Trump’s direction, completed Wednesday and set to be refilled by Sunday. While Trump claims the project cost under $2 million, contracts totaling at least $14.8 million have been awarded. A nonprofit has sued to stop the work, calling it a ‘theme park’ makeover.

articles.title: Trump to Announce $700 Million Coal Revival, Invoking Cold War-Era Law
articles.summary: President Trump is set to announce nearly $700 million in spending to prop up coal-fired power plants and exports, using the Defense Production Act. The plan would support 13 existing plants, build the first new ones since 2013, and create an estimated 14,000 jobs. Environmental groups call it a taxpayer-funded boost for a polluting industry.
